description: This file implements a Bootstrap datepicker widget, including the Datepicker class, global configuration, and template HTML for the datepicker UI.

classes.name: Datepicker
classes.description: Main class for the Bootstrap datepicker widget, handling display, user interaction, and date management.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the formatted date value into the input or element.

methods.name: place
methods.description: Positions the datepicker popup relative to the input element.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the internal date state based on input value.

methods.name: fillDow
methods.description: Fills the day-of-week header in the calendar.

methods.name: fillMonths
methods.description: Fills the month selection in the calendar.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Renders the calendar days, months, and years based on current view.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Handles click events within the calendar for date selection and navigation.

methods.name: showMode
methods.description: Switches between day, month, and year views.
